module_name: Autodesk Inventor CAD Unified Function Index
description: Top-level index for Autodesk Inventor CAD-side (Part / Assembly / Drawing environments) operations. Inventor is a feature-based parametric MCAD system with first-class sheet-metal, frame-generator, and weldment workspaces that have no Fusion 360 / hyperCAD-S equivalent. Coverage spans 8 environments: Sketch (2D constraint solver), Part (3D solid features), Surface (lofted / boundary / patch / stitch), Sheet Metal (face / flange / contour roll / unfold), Frame Generator (skeleton / frame member / notch / extend / trim / lengthen), Weldment (preparation / weld bead / machining), Drawing (multi-view / annotation), and Assembly (component / constraint / joint / pattern). Consumed by InventorCADFunctionIndexEngine for parameter discovery and AI orchestration of Inventor automation via the COM API + iLogic.

modules.description: 2D parametric sketcher: 9 primitive families (Line, Rectangle in 4 modes, Circle in 3 modes, Arc in 4 modes, Ellipse, Polygon inscribed/circumscribed, Spline interpolation/control, Slot in 4 modes, Point), 8 editing tools (Trim, Extend, Break, Offset, Mirror, Move, Rotate, Scale), 1 reference-projection family (Project Geometry / Project to Surface / Intersect Curve), 13 geometric constraints, 7 dimension constraints, fillet/chamfer, sketch patterns (linear/circular), construction toggle, and text. Inventor sketches solve as a constraint network — every entity carries a sketch-DOF count surfaced through AddCoincident etc.

3D solid features (Part environment): 6 sweep features (Extrude / Revolve / Sweep / Loft / Coil / Rib), Hole + Thread (5 head types × 4 termination types × 8 thread standards), 4 modify features (Fillet / Chamfer / Shell / Draft), Combine boolean (Join/Cut/Intersect), 5 pattern families (Rectangular / Circular / Mirror / Sketch-Driven / Path), Derive Component, Thicken-Offset, and 6 direct-edit/utility features (Delete Face / Split Body / Copy Object / Move Body / Emboss). All bindings reference real Inventor COM API (ComponentDefinition.Features.*).

Surface modeling environment (thinner than hyperCAD-S — Inventor's surface tools are oriented around closure, repair, and surface→solid conversion rather than primary modeling). 12 operations: Boundary Patch (G0/G1/G2 continuity), Stitch / Unstitch, Trim Surface, Extend Surface, Replace Face, Sculpt (surface→solid bridge), Ruled Surface (3 direction modes), Repair Bodies (heal/diagnose), Move Face (direct edit), Silhouette Curve, Surface Intersect.

Sheet metal environment — Inventor's signature workspace with no Fusion 360 / hyperCAD-S equivalent of comparable depth. 21 operations driven by a Sheet Metal Rule that carries thickness / K-factor / bend radius / unfold method. Coverage: base creation (Face, Contour Flange, Contour Roll, Lofted Flange in 3 press modes), edge features (Flange in 12 params, Hem in 4 types, Bend, Fold in 9 params, Jog), corner treatments (Corner Seam in 5 types, Chamfer, Round, Rip), special features (Cut with affect-bend, Punch from iFeature library in 10 params, Emboss), unfold/refold workflow, and Flat Pattern (14 params) emission for downstream CAM/nesting + the Sheet Metal Rule + Defaults objects themselves.

Frame Generator environment — Inventor-only assembly-level workspace with no Fusion 360 / hyperCAD-S equivalent. 12 operations across member placement (Insert Frame Member with 9-position alignment grid + Custom1/Custom2 offsets + Content Center family selection, Change, Reuse, Author custom Content Center frame member from sketch profile), end treatments (Mitre single+double, Notch profile/face/dual-face, Trim-To-Frame, Extend-To-Frame, Trim-and-Extend with auto-detect, Lengthen/Shorten, Remove End Treatment), and Frame BOM emission (CSV/XLSX/XML/parts-list with cut-list grouping + end-treatment summaries). Skeleton-driven: each member is bound to a sketch line in a parent skeleton part. Bindings reference FrameComponentDefinition COM API (FrameMembers / MitreFrameMembers / NotchFrameMembers / TrimFrameMembers / ExtendFrameMembers / TrimExtendFrameMembers / LengthenShortenFrameMembers / RemoveEndTreatments collections + ContentCenterEditor.AuthorFrameMember).

Weldment environment — assembly subtype activated by Convert-to-Weldment, enforces a 3-phase build order (Preparations → Welds → Machining). 12 operations: setup (Convert-to-Weldment with 6 welding standards: AWS A2.4, ISO 2553, DIN ISO 2553, JIS Z 3021, GB/T 324, ANSI Y14.5), preparations (Cope for tubular saddle joints, Chamfer for V/bevel/J/U groove prep, Edge-Fillet for stress-relief), weld beads (Cosmetic annotation-only with intermittent stitch params, Fillet 2-or-3-face with leg/throat/contour/all-around/intermittent, Groove with full/partial penetration + root-opening + reinforcement + backing-bar + double-sided), Machining post-weld (hole/cut/face/fillet/chamfer with hole/extrude/revolve/sweep modes), Weld Symbol AWS A2.4-compliant drawing annotation (15 weld types with arrow/other/both side, finish symbols G/M/C/H/R, tail text), End Fill cap for hollow members, Multi-Pass Weld Schedule (root + filler + cap with SMAW/GMAW/FCAW/GTAW/SAW/ESW/EW process), and Weldment BOM with bead length + bead volume + electrode mass + deposition efficiency. Bindings reference WeldmentComponentDefinition COM API (Preparations / WeldBeads / MachiningFeatures / WeldPasses collections + AddCopeFeature / AddChamferFeature / AddFilletEdgeFeature / AddFilletWeldBead / AddCosmeticWeldBead / AddGrooveWeldBead / AddWeldEndFill methods + WeldSymbol drawing-side annotation).

future_modules.scope: 2D drawing output: Base View, Projected View, Section View (Full / Half / Aligned / Offset), Detail View, Auxiliary View, Break View, Crop View, dimensions (Linear / Angular / Radius / Diameter / Chamfer / Baseline / Ordinate / Hole Table / Bend Table for sheet metal flat patterns), Note / Leader / Surface Texture / Weld Symbol / GD&T Frame, Title Block + Revision Table + Parts List.

Assembly: Place Component, Pattern (Component-Pattern / Mirror), Constraints (Mate / Flush / Angle / Tangent / Insert / Symmetry / Rotation), Joints (Rigid / Rotational / Slider / Cylindrical / Planar / Ball — replaces legacy constraints in modern Inventor), Adaptivity, Frame Analysis, Bill of Materials, Interference Analysis.
